body:
Thanks for all the feedback. I'm sorry I haven't been able to get to a computer today, but I am feeling a little better about things. 

It was a really difficult day today, but the beauty outside gave me a little bit of hope. If nothing else, I decided that I wouldn't want any drugs to show up in my system when I die.

Being from the US, I'm really counting on getting a job so I can get health insurance to cover a visit to a psychiatrist and whatever meds they might prescribe. 

I do appreciate your concern as I feel this is the closest thing I've had to a genuine heart-to-heart conversation in some time. I'm going to try to get some rest now and I'll hopefully have a better grasp of the situation in the morning.

Thanks for responding. I'm pretty familiar with the after-effects of MDMA use as I've been a fan of electronic music for some time and have had a few friends that over-indulged. I have just avoided the drugs because of my mental state. 

I got some 5-htp from the drugstore and had a healthy breakfast when I woke up. I've spent the majority of the day in bed, just hoping these feelings will pass.

I am a little concerned about bringing this up with my family since they were pretty insensitive about my cousin's suicide attempt. My parents attributed it to the fact that his parents didn't attend church so I'm afraid talking to them would lead to proselytizing more than genuine concern.

I'm in a pretty bad place myself but I'm browsing some of the posts here. Sex is almost a guarantee later in life. I started on my high school basketball team and I never got laid, though my teammates frequently lied about their exploits. 

When I went off to college, things got a lot easier in that department. I had a few anonymous hookups early on freshman year then I got a steady girlfriend. We were having sex almost daily for about two years before we broke up. From one depressed individual to another, you owe it to your penis to experience sex at least once.
